sentences.en: I intend to put this matter to the Bureau tonight.
sentences.zh: 今晚我想把这个事情向办公室汇报。

sentences.en: Nobody can put anything over on the bureau chief.
sentences.zh: 没有人能蒙混过关局长。

sentences.en: The weather bureau says it will rain tonight.
sentences.zh: 气象局预报今天晚上会下雨。

senses.zh: 局，处，司；（政府的）部门；办公桌，写字台
